title: I Used the Tenant Mailbox Camera Through Three Carrier Days After They Cut the Slot

parts.text: Day one they cut the outgoing slot and posted a camera that faced only inbound. I was forty-four, tenant, holding a certified letter that still needed a slot. At 10:22 a.m. the camera watched inbound and, I found, not the table where packages sat unattended. Temporary, the super said. I photographed the cut slot, the table, the time. Then a tote I did not recognize used the table toward the stair. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized tote just used the package table toward the stair.

social.video_title: They cut the outgoing slot and aimed the camera inbound — Part 1/3
social.description: Certified letter, a blind table, a tote toward the stair. Would you have followed the tote?

parts.text: Day two I followed with the stills. The stair cam (there was none) did not take the tote. The person palmed envelopes that were not inbound I could see from the lobby cone. I was still forty-four, still the file. I messaged management the table still and stayed in the cone. The person looked at the cone, then at the last unlocked outgoing box row. I did not chase. I carbon-copied. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the outgoing boxes; management now has the still.

social.video_title: The tote went to a stair with no camera — Part 2/3
social.description: Envelopes off-inbound, a lobby cone, unlocked boxes next. Management has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: Management locked the outgoing row from the office. The person left the tote and the letters. Morning recoded the camera to the table and restored the slot. The super who called it temporary lost the cut. I keep a certified receipt. Cameras watch tables now, not vibes. The lobby at 10:22 sounds like a lobby, which is to say mail and nobody's tote. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.video_title: Morning aimed the camera at the table — Part 3/3
social.description: Restored slot, a lost cut, cameras on the table. Was temporary ever a stair?
